calls.title: Willson Liu and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting aimed to improve prompt tracking and content generation for Ashley Stirrup's team. A curated list of 161 relevant prompts was developed, prioritizing AB testing and feature flags to align with product team needs. Ashley's monthly streaming plan was confirmed to cover 1400 prompts, ensuring sustainability. The discussions included a detailed look at a 17-step AI-driven content workflow that produces 40 articles monthly, alongside a proposal to pilot test this against Athena’s platform. Immediate data streaming was initiated for performance comparisons, while new features like Olympus for content influence visualization and Oracle for misinformation detection were introduced. Future collaborations and follow-up sessions were planned to refine workflows and explore case study opportunities.
calls.keywords: Athena platform, AB testing, feature flags, content generation, Olympus visualization, AI agent
